messages.author: de6aac5651aaf2a3
messages.subject: variance related warning message in path analysis
parts:
Dear lavaan users,

I have a path analysis which runs OK, but gives the following warning message:

"Warning message:
In getDataFull(data = data, group = group, group.label = group.label,  :
  lavaan WARNING: some observed variances are (at least) a factor 1000 times larger than others; please rescale"

Why is this message generated? Is this a problem or can I just ignore this message?

Thank you in advance!

Attila

messages.author: 99a06696c483481a
messages.subject: Re: variance related warning message in path analysis
parts:
Surprising things happen in SEM when observed variables differ substantially in scale.  the warning is giving you good advice.  You can easily rescale by, for example, dividing your larger-scale variables by some power of 10.  Diving the variable by 10 divides its variance by 100.
--Ed Rigdon

messages.subject: Re: variance related warning message in path analysis
parts:
On 09/28/2013 05:23 PM, F�l�p Attila wrote:
> Dear lavaan users,
>
> I have a path analysis which runs OK, but gives the following warning
> message:
>
> "Warning message:
> In getDataFull(data = data, group = group, group.label = group.label, :
> lavaan WARNING: some observed variances are (at least) a factor 1000
> times larger than others; please rescale"

99% of the time, this warning is completely harmless; but you should
still check your data, eg by typing:

varTable(fit)

to identify the variables with (very) large variances. Rescale the
variable(s), and fit again.

Yves.
